from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def _canon(cells):
    pts=list(cells)
    forms=[]
    for refl in (1,-1):
        for k in range(4):
            q=[]
            for x,y in pts:
                x,y=x*refl,y
                for _ in range(k): x,y=y,-x
                q.append((x,y))
            a=min(x for x,y in q); b=min(y for x,y in q)
            forms.append(tuple(sorted((x-a,y-b) for x,y in q)))
    return min(forms)

def _components(g, bg):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=g[r][c]; q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); pts=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.pop(); pts.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    z=(x+dx,y+dy)
                    if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and g[z[0]][z[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(z); q.append(z)
            out.append((color,pts))
    return out

def _is_l(pts):
    rs=[x for x,y in pts]; cs=[y for x,y in pts]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    if r0==r1 or c0==c1: return False
    return len(pts)==(r1-r0+1)+(c1-c0+1)-1 and (all(any(x==r for x,y in pts) for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and all(any(y==c for x,y in pts) for c in range(c0,c1+1)))

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(g,bg)
    ls=[(col,pts) for col,pts in comps if _is_l(pts)]
    if not ls: return g
    marker,marker_pts=max(ls,key=lambda z:len(z[1]))
    others=[(col,pts) for col,pts in comps if pts is not marker_pts]
    groups={}
    for col,pts in others:
        groups.setdefault(_canon(pts),[]).append((col,pts))
    repeated=[items for items in groups.values() if len(items)>1]
    if not repeated: return g
    # The object farther down in the repeated-shape pair is the one recolored.
    candidates=[]
    for items in repeated:
        ordered=sorted(items,key=lambda z:(sum(r for r,c in z[1])/len(z[1]), min(r for r,c in z[1])))
        candidates.append(ordered[-1][1])
    target=max(candidates,key=lambda pts:(sum(r for r,c in pts)/len(pts), max(r for r,c in pts)))
    for r,c in target: g[r][c]=marker
    return g
'''
